title: Is olive oil safe at high heat? Does it taste bad?
summary: Adam Ragusea examines whether olive oil is unsafe for high-heat cooking and whether it tastes bad when heated. He cites studies showing it is among the most stable cooking oils and that smoke-point worries are overblown.
why: HN points to it to debunk the stubborn olive-oil-at-high-heat myth, valued for its cited sources and food scientist interviews.

quote.text: Adam Ragusea did a great video on the topic, with cited sources. I highly recommend watching it
